intro.name: The setup
intro.text: A villager finds an abandoned-looking egg or hatchling.

a.name: Outcome A
a.text: A naturalist identifies its species and returns it to a safe nesting site.

b.name: Outcome B
b.text: The apparent abandonment was a misunderstanding; the parent returns.

c.name: Outcome C
c.text: The villager becomes attached but chooses not to interfere with the wild family.
